summary: Reproduced the review gap: the candidate helper test passes with runner replay staging disabled. Preserved its valid cases and added a failing-before/passing-after integration regression for runner staging, pointer-stable capture buffers, DSV4 replay layout resolution, and a 160-live-token layout rounded to tier 192. No justified production source change was found on the prepared source.

tests.command: controlled mutation: disable DecodeCudaGraphRunner._stage_ragged_verify_layout, then run candidate issue-specific helper test
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the candidate regression does not detect removal of runner replay staging.
All three consolidated integration cases failed against broken staging, including DSV4 resolution and the lower-token same-tier boundary.
15 focused helper and integration tests passed after restoring production staging.
Real gfx950 execution of runner staging for 32x6 and 32x5 layouts into a 192-slot capture; the latter assigned tokens to 32 synthetic slots.

gpu_execution_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 under ROCm 7.2 executed DecodeCudaGraphRunner._stage_ragged_verify_layout device tensor copies and padding kernels for both reviewed geometries.
remaining_limitations: The exact four-NVIDIA-H20 TP4 DeepSeek-V4-Flash CUDA Graph replay was not executable in the assigned single-gfx950 environment.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark model weights were unavailable.
CUDA/Hopper behavior, distributed collectives, full DSV4 attention execution, model semantics, and the serving workload remain unverified.
No production source defect was found from the available source-level and gfx950 evidence; a speculative runtime change was therefore not made.
